...Thru the Bible with Dr. J. Vernon McGee Exodus 16...

Imagine you were going hungry and God made it rain heavenly bread for you. Join us as Dr. McGee teaches through Exodus 16, when God sent manna to the children of Israel as a symbol of His promise to satisfy our souls as the true Bread of Life.

https://ttb.org/

...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

Set yourself aside

Now I’m of the opinion that many of us today are missing a great blessing. Suppose you’re going through a particular time of trial, trouble, why not set yourself aside to God? You’re a Christian, and you don’t want to get hurt in all of this. You want to live for God, don’t you? And so you set yourself aside for God in a very definite way, to walk closer with Him. And it will make the trial—now it won’t remove the trial, but it will make it more bearable, let me say. And He says, “Take my yoke upon you; learn of me, I am meek and lowly,” and it’s nice to be yoked up with Him.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/set-yourself-aside-1293682.html

https://ttb.org/

...Daily Promises...

But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him. (Hebrews 11:6)

What is faith? It is trusting in the work of another. Therefore, we cannot please Him until we place all our trust and faith in Christ; for He is the author and finisher of our faith who will reward those who will seek His face.

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm
